text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: svc-inference-prod — 5xx spike on release rollout (traffic stutter in canary pool). Auto-threshold hit: canary-error-rate > 8% for 3m. link: https://telemetry.redwood/graphs/xyz

anya (oncall): acked via PagerDuty. I’m looking — will collect logs.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: Incident assigned to anya (oncall). Incident key: PD-823114.

anya (oncall): quick check: canary pool is a small subset (20 nodes). p95 latency up, error rate noisy. Running `kubectl -n inference get pods -l rollout=canary -o wide` now.

chris (sre): pinging infra. do we have recent kernel/driver changes in this rollout?

leah (eng): last commit for rollout: ship/rlhf-quant-path. No infra changes in this release; just model and config. But we did flip new batching flag for canary nodes.

anya (oncall): logs from one canary pod (snippet):
```
2026-02-18T01:09:41Z ERROR inference: request failed: downstream-kernel SIGBUS at quant_exec.cpp:214
2026-02-18T01:09:41Z WARN kvcache: fallback to cold fetch
2026-02-18T01:09:42Z ERROR http: 502 from model-worker
```

ops-runbot: Automated mitigation suggestion: reduce canary traffic to 0% and route to fallback model pool. Command: `redwood traffic set svc-inference-prod --canary 0 --reason automated_pager`

anya (oncall): running the traffic diversion now. `redwood traffic set svc-inference-prod --canary 0`

incident-bot: Routing update: canary traffic reduced to 0% (applied by anya). Telemetry will reflect changes in ~30s. :gear:

chris (sre): good call. start collecting heap/dmesg from affected nodes before we rotate. can someone `gcloud compute ssh` into node host-quant-11 and grab dmesg?

leah (eng): grabbing dumps now. initial hypothesis: quantized kernel path triggered a bad codepath on longer sequences; SIGBUS could be memory alignment/quant kernel bug.

anya (oncall): PagerDuty: added note that mitigation in progress and customer impact is 'elevated error rate on experimental canary only'. No broadly visible customer impact yet.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-823114 status changed to acknowledged by anya.

chris (sre): I’m going to escalate to eng oncall for rollback decision — paging leah.

leah (eng): oncall response: saw the dmesg traces, collecting core. Recommend rollback of the model/serving config that enabled the new batching path. If rollback takes time, keep canary at 0 and roll forward with old config to the rest of fleet.

anya (oncall): what’s customer-facing plan? If rollback occurs quickly (<15m) we mark as mitigated; otherwise prepare status update.

chris (sre): we'll hold on global rollout. stalling the release: `releases pause ship/rlhf-quant-path` (executed).

ops-runbot: Release control: rollout paused by chris (sre).

anya (oncall): I’m drafting a short internal post for #general (ops) and product: "Canary observed 5xx spike after new batching config in canary. Diverted canary traffic and paused rollout. Investigating root cause; no customer-wide impact detected at this time."

leah (eng): starting rollback job: `ci rollback --release ship/rlhf-quant-path --to previous`. ETA ~6m for rollback to propagate to canary image.

incident-bot: Change emitted: rollback job queued by leah.

anya (oncall): monitoring logs: error rate trending down after diversion; p50/p95 latency dropping. Good sign.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-823114 escalated to L2 (eng) as of 8032104583.

chris (sre): confirm we have captured core and kernel logs; tag them to the incident ticket PD-823114. Also set retention on logs (save for 90d) for postmortem.

leah (eng): rollback completed for canary at 8032104590. Verified model-worker restarts completed.

anya (oncall): telemetry shows error rate back to baseline on canary. Doing smoke test against a few sample prompts.

leah (eng): still collecting cores for deeper debug; I’ll open a follow-up GitHub issue with the failing sequence and upload traces.

anya (oncall): updating PD: mitigated by rollback and traffic diversion; monitoring for recurrence. Customer impact: limited to experimentation — no customer API errors observed in production traffic beyond canary.

pagerduty-bot: PD-823114 status changed to resolved by anya at 8032104595.

chris (sre): quick retro notes: 1) batching flag rollout should include a preflight under stress on low-level kernels; 2) add automated canary autosuppress to pause rollout on kernel-level SIG faults; 3) ensure rollback path is tested.

anya (oncall): thanks all. I’ll prepare the incident summary and assign owners for follow-ups. If anyone sees any residual blips, ping here. :thumbsup:

ops-runbot: Incident close checklist: logs archived, PD ticket updated, rollback verified, owners assigned.

leah (eng): opened GH issue: GH-6278 with traces and steps to reproduce. Assigning to infra/quant-team.

anya (oncall): closing thread for now."
